info.name: WeDelivery Backend Tests (full suite)
info.description:
Full backend test suite — every area in one run. The same tests are also available one file per area in postman/tests/.

Folder 0 must run first (logs in and stores tokens). Each run creates 2 users and 1 order; vehicle changes are undone. Against the AWS database (SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE=aws) those users and orders are real and stay there.

HOW TO RUN: start the backend, then right-click the collection → Run collection → Run. It is self-contained (logs in by itself) and repeatable. baseUrl defaults to http://localhost:8080 (collection → Variables). Seeded accounts use password123.

exec: pm.test('generic login error message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('Invalid username or password.'));
pm.test('generic login error message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('Invalid username or password.'));
